include_class.description: Filter to only events with this class (PUBLIC, CONFIDENTIAL, PRIVATE, NONE).

exclude_class.description: Exclude events with this class (PUBLIC, CONFIDENTIAL, PRIVATE, NONE).

include_categories.description: List of category names to include in the output.

exclude_categories.description: List of category names to exclude from the output.

include_description.description: Include the event's long description in a <PRE> block.

include_location.description: Include the event's location in a <PRE> block.

html_title.description: Text to use for the HTML page title.

footer_text.description: Text to add at the bottom of the HTML file.

mark_today.description: Mark the current day with #today in the HTML file.

timezone.description: Adjust for this timezone, specified as country/city.

monday_first.description: Draw Monday as the first day of the week (Sunday is default).

start_date.description: The start date for the calendar view in yyyymmdd format.

duration.description: The duration of the calendar view, in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., P5W, P60D).

input_file.description: Path to the input iCalendar file. Defaults to standard input if empty.
